reported_issue: Character combat targets hard to select, with stutter.
findings: Old fixed 101px hitboxes missed wide vehicle ends and large-enemy areas; DOM hit-testing confirmed points landed on the canvas instead of target buttons.
Character frames rendered hidden road scenery beneath the battle arena. Pure command browsing replaced the full page and canvas and serialized saves.
The desktop test did not reproduce a permanent freeze; actual user phone performance remains unmeasured.
browser_checks: Chrome 360x780: target buttons and stage targeting both commit attacks.
Rapid double-click killed the middle enemy once; round advanced from 1 to 2 only once, defeated slot remained empty.
Next attack targeted the surviving right enemy, HP 100 to 90. Psychic power targeted left enemy, HP 100 to 89 and ESP 18 to 15; next round accepted input.
Medicine selected a party member, consumed one medicine and returned to commands.
Four party members committed separate attacks, advanced automatically to each member, completed all actions and reached round 2.
Stage upper points previously missing targets now resolve to targetEnemy. Document dimensions 360x780 match viewport.

performance_sample.case: Three character enemies at route segment 91, same local Chrome mobile viewport; 120 steady painted frames after 30 warmup frames.
performance_sample.scope: Canvas JavaScript callback measurements on desktop Chrome, not GPU or physical phone FPS.

limitations: Physical phone and Safari not tested.
